name: std::byteswap

declarations.code:
template <class T>

constexpr T byteswap(T n) noexcept;

intro:
Reverses the bytes in the given integer value n.

std::byteswap participates in overload resolution only if T satisfies integral, i.e., T is an integer type. The program is ill-formed if T has padding bits.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An integer value of type T whose object representation comprises the bytes of that of n in reversed order.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
This function is useful for processing data of different endianness.

guides.name: std::byteswap
guides.summary: Reverse the bytes inside an integer.
guides.analogy: Like reversing the order of the boxes in a delivery, while leaving the contents of each box alone.
guides.signature:
template<class T>
constexpr T byteswap(T value) noexcept;
guides.note: This example assumes a 16-bit unsigned short. The type must be integral and have no padding bits.
